title: Outdoor Roasted Australian Carrot Skewers
description: A nutty and shattering Australian dish featuring carrots and candy, perfect for a hangover cure, roasted to perfection on a cedar plank. This satvik-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.

ingredients.name: candy pieces
ingredients.notes: such as peanut butter cups or caramel candies

ingredients.name: cedar plank
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for at least 30 minutes

instructions: Soak the cedar plank in water for at least 30 minutes before cooking.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the carrot pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the peanut oil onto the carrots, then sprinkle with honey, candy pieces, pecans, salt, and pepper.
Place the skewers on the cedar plank and put the plank on the grill.
Close the grill lid and cook for 20 minutes, or until the carrots are tender and lightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the carrot skewers hot, garnished with additional candy pieces and pecans if desired.
